title: Psalms
author: Written by David, Asaph, the sons of Korah, Solomon, Moses, and others.
date: Collected over many centuries of Israel's worship life.
audience: God's people in worship, prayer, lament, praise, repentance, and hope.
historicalSetting: Psalms is Israel's prayer and worship book, giving voice to praise, sorrow, trust, confession, and expectation of the Lord's reign.
keyVerse: Psalms 23:1 — "Yahweh is my shepherd: I shall lack nothing."
christFocus: The Psalms point constantly to Christ: the righteous King, the suffering Servant, the Shepherd, the Son, and the One through whom God's kingdom comes.
